rules.name: Exploit Public-Facing Application
rules.description: Detects exploitation of public-facing web applications, APIs, and services
rules.query:
let threshold = 5;
initial_access_events
| where initial_access has_any("mitre", "initial-access", "exploit", "web-application")
| summarize count() by SourceIP, bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
| where count_ > threshold
